name: detectai-worker-payments (${environment})
description: Payments consumer: queue payment_events, Paddle API, dedup, reconcile. service.name = worker-payments.

pages.name: Worker payments
pages.description: Paddle API health, dedup, end-to-end reconcile lag

rawConfiguration.text:
## Worker payments (`worker-payments`, `${environment}`)
Queue `payment_events` (`subscription.created|updated|canceled`, `user.cancel`). Paddle client timeout 10s, env `sandbox|production`. End-to-end = gateway webhook -> worker -> DB. Dedup via `EVENT_REDIS_URL`.

nrqlQueries.query: FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `msgs/min` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'
FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}'

FROM Span SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (name LIKE '%paddle%' OR `http.host` LIKE '%paddle%')
FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS dups WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%duplicate%' OR message LIKE '%dedup%')
FROM Log SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET `event.type` TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET name TIMESERIES AUTO LIMIT 10

FROM Span SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 50, 95, 99) WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (name LIKE '%paddle%' OR `http.host` LIKE '%paddle%') TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT count(*) WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND `http.status_code` IN ('429', '500', '502', '503') TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS rpm, percentage(count(*), WHERE error = true) AS `error %`, average(duration.ms) AS `avg ms` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' FACET name LIMIT 20

FROM Log SELECT count(*) AS n, latest(message) AS sample WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' AND (message LIKE '%transition%' OR message LIKE '%Invalid%' OR message LIKE '%poison%' OR level = 'error') FACET message LIMIT 20
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `gateway/min` WHERE service.name = 'payment-gateway' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
FROM Span SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS `worker/min` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO

FROM Metric SELECT average(process_runtime_nodejs_eventloop_lag_ms) AS `loop lag ms`, average(process_heap_used_bytes / 1000000) AS `heap MB` WHERE service.name = 'worker-payments' AND deployment.environment = '${environment}' TIMESERIES AUTO
